title: Team Talk Questions

blocks.text: Select up to three prompts. Copy your chosen questions into a Google Doc and project them, or display the selected questions another way.
Give pairs or small groups one prompt to discuss, then invite sharing or rotate questions if time allows. Encourage story evidence and different perspectives.

items: Why do you think Zoe decided to switch teams?
Do you think Zoe should have spoken to Maddie before changing the team arrangement? Why or why not?
Which character do you understand the most? Explain.
Have you ever been left out of a group, team, or activity? How did it feel?
Can a friendship still be strong when plans suddenly change?
What is the difference between choosing what is popular and choosing what is right?
When someone feels disappointed, what are healthy ways to respond?
What do you think lies ahead for Maddie and Zoe?
What makes a team successful besides talent or skill?
What clue from this quest do you think might help restore the sparkle later in the mission?

source_note: One-page teacher companion, ten original Part 04 prompts. Sharing instructions moved from Teacher Guide as requested.
